We had only two representatives in the match against TVH at Cranford on February 14th; Tony Brooks (8th) and Nigel Bacon (9th). It was a pity we didn't have a full turn out, for TVH have a strong batch of Juniors and Youths and would have provided useful experience for our youngsters.
CONGRATULATIONS To 'Big' Bill Curtin and Nigel Bacon who journied to Warrington, paid their own fare,56/- each, for competition. Big Bill, I understand, won the mile in 4 mins. 44 secs.
Young Nigel Bacon, competing in his first "six", did well to put five seniors behind him. What is more, he looked fresher than many of his opponents.
The battle for 2nd place was not so clear cut though, Nigel Bacon and Richard King tying at 89 points with Mick Harvey just one point behind
NIGEL BACON REPORTS:- Over 700 entries had been received from as far apart as Scotland and Cornwall for this, the largest meeting in Britain apart from the All-England Schools.
Fastest Times: W.Curtin 8:51, N.Bacon 9:04, V.Butcher 9:29, R.Langley 10:00

Nigel Bacon started and, as always, ran his heart out. Nigel is a real team runner and on this occasion proved it; he could hardly stand at the finish and certainly deserved better than 17th position.

Cliff Calderwood looked as if he would make the scoring five when John Hamilton faded away but he was outrun by Nigel Bacon and Robert Poole who clinched third place for Belgrave in a close team result.
We have over a dozen regular members now, the Hamilton and Day twins forming the nucleus with John Crockford and Nigel Bacon making our first six.

Ideal for the throwers perhaps and, in Nigel Bacon's case, for his running also! Reg Hopkins and Tom Carter have been taking movie films from time to time, and they hope to put on a show in the near future.

This was our first trip to this venue and, on unfamiliar country, Vic Butcher, Nigel Bacon & Robert Poole all went off course. The race was a mixed youths & boys event and Bill Curtin was the first boy to finish.
Only one other boy,who was not Belgrave, managed to reach so far before 10 o'clock. N.Bacon 12 Bridges 70 mins.
But how about Nigel 'Danish' Bacon. What kind of decorated hot-rod for Datona or Southend beach and what about MacLennon, Mead and Kelly, our redoubtable Keystone boys?
I think, however, that the most popular pastime was throwing Nigel Bacon in the swimming pool ! We played some good games of football too (we have quite a good team - how about a match you seniors?)

A word of thanks to Nigel Bacon who was too old to run at this meeting; this did not stop him from breaking into his holiday and coming all the way from Brighton to cheer us on in his own inimitable way.

The fans went wild (Nigel Bacon had to be held down!) What a fine birthday present this was for their 'leader' Reg Hopkins. Vic Butcher improved on his best time for the 1000 metres Steeplechase with 3:02, only 2 seconds outside A.A.A.

Belgrave had four athletes in the London team, and to support them, our junior member NIGEL BACON who reports on the meeting. It was a real pleasure to travel with, and watch, this happy-go-lucky London Schools Team.

Nigel Bacon went along to support our lads, and quite a useful friendship was brought about with the members of Small Heath Harriers; the parents of these boys being kind enough to give our lads accommodation and transport, without charge.

"There I was, acting perfectly normal running laps around the Crystal Palace hostel in the dark when this bird called Sheila Sherwood or something called out 'Who are you? and what are you doing down there?' Well, she may not understand midnight training but you'd think she would have heard of Nigel Bacon by now!"
Thanks also to Nigel Bacon who gave two prizes, one each to the last scoring boy in each team. All in all a most worthwhile afternoon's sport.
Cliff Calderwood and Nigel Bacon are two examples. Mick Day was our most consistent performer with placings of 7th,6th and 4th in the first three races but unfortunately missed the last match.

"Vic Butcher would like me to say that his friendship with a certain young lady is not at all serious (they are just good friends!) and it will not interfere with his training".
